title: Data and code for: Opposite parity of the in-plane and out-of-plane Ni-O-Mn exchange displaces the Curie maximum of biaxially strained La2NiMnO6 toward compression
description: Quantum ESPRESSO inputs and outputs (2x2 factorial spin-configuration design at eleven biaxial strain states, Hubbard-U scan, isotropic pilot, k-mesh test), classical Heisenberg Monte Carlo data, derived data files and analysis/plotting scripts for N. Paran, submitted to the Journal of Magnetism and Magnetic Materials (2026). README.md maps every table and figure to its data file and script; scripts/reproduce_all.sh regenerates all derived data files from the outputs. Relaxed structures and the vc-relax runs are in the companion data set doi:10.5281/zenodo.24353930.
